headline: Microsoft generated $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI in its September quarter
body: Microsoft says it generated $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ended September 30. That is nearly 11% of its total quarterly revenue of $92.3 billion.
note: The partnership still brings in a large share of Microsoft's revenue, even as the two companies compete for the same customers.

evidence.text: Microsoft generated $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ended September 30, the company said in a regulatory filing on Wednesday.

That represents nearly 11% of Microsoft’s total quarterly revenue of $92.3 billion, highlighting the enormous financial ties that remain between the two companies even as they increasingly compete for the same customers .
